newsitem.title: UK: European jet fuel dips with futures, market slow.
newsitem.headline: European jet fuel dips with futures, market slow.

text.p: European jet fuel was lacklustre on Wednesday with marginally weaker futures gently pulling outright prices lower, traders said.
May IPE gas oil was seven cents lower at $163.50 a tonne.
Material remained tight for April, although late April-early May cargoes were offered, traders said.
They said barge premiums held steady at around May IPE gas oil +$18 fob ARA while cargo premiums were pegged around +$24-25 NWE, although most talk was quotes related at +$2 over.

In the Mediterranean Libyan was offered around high fob quotes +$6 with bids about $2 off this. EU grade was offered around high fob quotes +$9-10, but buyers were reluctant to move higher than +$7-8, traders said.
